_comment: The inventory is the one place a declared board meets what is on the bus. A match rule that loosens reports the wrong board as present; a caller that stops reading the row reports every board offline; a builder filter reintroduces the tracked-in-the-UI-but-not-the-CLI split this module exists to end.

mutations.name: exactly one sighting is a match, never the first of several
mutations.find: match = matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
mutations.replace: match = matches[0] if matches else None

mutations.name: every builder's types are joined, not just kconfig's
mutations.replace: for entry in [e for e in entries if e.builder == "kconfig_make"]:

mutations.name: a kconfig board's state is read from its inventory row
mutations.find: state = row.state if row is not None else STATE_OFFLINE

mutations.name: a cmake board's presence is read from its inventory row
mutations.find: present = device_row is not None and device_row.present
